description: This file defines the AnalysisOrchestratorService class, which manages the entire analysis pipeline for resumes, including ATS checks, skill extraction, suggestions, and job recommendations. It coordinates multiple repositories and services to process resume texts either asynchronously or synchronously.

classes.name: AnalysisOrchestratorService
classes.description: Coordinates the resume analysis pipeline, including ATS checks, skill extraction, suggestions, and recommendations, integrating several repositories and services.

methods.name: None _run_analysis_pipeline(self, analysis_id: int, user_id: int, text: Optional[str])
methods.description: Executes the main analysis steps: updates status, evaluates ATS, stores findings, suggestions, extracts skills, and creates recommendations.

methods.name: int start_analysis_for_resume( self, user_id: int, resume_id: int, text: Optional[str], background_tasks: BackgroundTasks )
methods.description: Creates an analysis record and schedules the analysis pipeline to run asynchronously in the background.

methods.name: int analyze_text(self, user_id: int, text: Optional[str], target_role: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Performs synchronous analysis of text: creates an analysis record, runs ATS checks and skill extraction, and stores results.

methods.name: None _create_recommendations(self, analysis_id: int, user_id: int, candidate_skills: List[str])
methods.description: Generates job recommendations based on candidate skills, recent jobs, and user preferences.
